input.title: Connect your first site
input.sub: Enter your WordPress site's address. We'll create a unique “connection key” for you to enter in the connector plugin — from then on, everything runs only through your server.
input.urlHint: Enter the full WordPress address, including any subdomain or folder, e.g. https://example.com/shop
input.discoveryFailed: Could not check this address. Verify the full WordPress address and try again.
input.detectedNote: WordPress responded at the address below. Confirm its location before creating the connection key.
input.connectorMissing: WordPress was found, but the connector is not visible in its API yet. Install and activate the plugin on this WordPress installation to connect.
input.editHint: Wrong location? Edit the address above and check again.

location.root: WordPress found at the domain root
location.subdomain-subfolder: WordPress found in a subdomain's subfolder

confirm.root: I confirm this is my WordPress address.
confirm.subfolder: I confirm WordPress is installed in the subfolder shown above.
confirm.subdomain: I confirm WordPress is installed on the subdomain shown above.
confirm.subdomain-subfolder: I confirm WordPress is installed in this subfolder on this subdomain.

input.pluginNote: Install the DigiWp Ai Bridge plugin and turn on “Connector Mode”. The plugin accepts only commands signed by your server and does nothing on the site on its own.
input.download: Download the DigiWp Ai Bridge plugin

pair.title: Pair the connector
pair.sub: On {name}: go to Tools → DigiWp Ai Bridge → Hub Connector Mode and enter these two values. This secret is shown only this once.
pair.failed: The connection isn't established yet. Check the connector settings and try again.
